name: Christmas Lights and Snowman
description: A Christmas voice skin with two faces. Christmas lights: a face strung from old-fashioned bulbs that twinkle, flash with your voice, chase while thinking and light up as it talks. Snowman: a coal-and-carrot snowman in a top hat who leans in to listen, swirls the snow while he thinks and talks with his coal smile.
author: Ponderosa

settings.title: Face
settings.description: Christmas lights is a face strung from bulbs on black. Snowman is a snowman in a top hat and scarf.

settings.title: Bulbs
settings.description: The colour of the bulbs. The pupils, nose and teeth keep their own colours.

settings.title: Bulb glow
settings.description: The soft light around each bulb. Turn off for a plainer look.

settings.title: Background
settings.description: Snowy night is a dark blue sky with moonlight behind him. Black is plain black. Snow falls in both.

settings.title: Frame rate
settings.description: Auto draws at the screen's full rate and drops to 30 frames a second on devices too slow to keep up. Pick 30 frames a second for slow devices such as the Echo Show 5.
